gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-parkinsans: Conthrax stretches out wide and geometric, its lowercase barely dipping below the capitals, while Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout. Conthrax is the showpiece; Parkinsans does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme reads friendly and open, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Conthrax brings heavy, uniform geometry on top, and the two feel like one modern system with a loud half and a quiet half.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-preahvihear: Wide, techy, almost machined. Preahvihear opens its letters like a pried oyster shell under Conthrax, and that lofty x-height keeps a long paragraph moving along one smooth thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption has bowls that feel unclosed and inviting, with big-bodied lowercase letters under the stroke-contrast-free Conthrax. And over a full page it stays professional and easy on the eye, a steady counterweight to the heading's wide geometry.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-puritan: Approachable is the first impression, since Puritan keeps its rounded forms open to the side and its e and a counters oversized beneath Conthrax's wide, clean geometry. The pairing's strongest quality is that no thin stroke ever disappears.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-questrial: Professional in tone, Questrial draws open c, e and s shapes at a single stroke weight, with a tall band of lowercase under short stalks. Over a long page it reads flat and smooth, a good quiet partner for Conthrax.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-radio-canada: Conthrax leads with wide, geometric capitals and a lowercase hardly shorter than them, while Radio Canada fills in beneath with tall, full c, s and z. Over a long stretch it moves along steadily, with every curve left open.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-radio-canada-big: Neutral and quiet, Radio Canada Big fills the line with its x-height. Conthrax is best at bold, wide geometric statements, while Radio Canada Big does its best work in monoline, open-ended text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro reads calm, with broad gaps at the terminals and barely any space between lowercase and caps. Over a long passage the weight never wavers from word to word, a smooth stretch after Conthrax's wide opening.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-ruda: Ruda reads open and screen-friendly, with a sizable x-height and a wire-like monoline skeleton under the wide, geometric Conthrax. Ruda keeps its wide-mouthed rounds consistent across a long stretch, so the text stays light and easy to follow.
